title: Prompt-Pay Interest on Repayments of Over-recoveries — Network Participation Agreements
content:
Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, Cascade pays prompt-pay interest on a repayment of an over-recovery on a Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement. An over-recovery is the amount by which a dispute decision lowered an overpayment below what had already been refunded or withheld on it. This rule covers only such repayment interest.

## Relation to clean-claim interest

A clean claim is paid within the clean-claim period of calendar days of receipt, and when it is paid later simple interest at the prompt-pay interest rate per year is paid for each day beyond that period as a separate prompt-pay interest component unless the interest is below the prompt-pay interest minimum; a repayment of an over-recovery on a capitation agreement is not such a clean claim, and its interest is worked out under this policy and only under it.

## Effect

The repayment interest is due once its conditions hold, and Cascade pays it. The payment is issued on its own remittance to the agreement's payee account. It is entered on the agreement's payment ledger as a prompt-pay interest component and carries a new remittance advice number that the practice sees on its remittance advice.

## Invocation: `pay_repayment_interest_bafa5446`

**Capability.** The tool pays a practice the prompt-pay interest owed on money Cascade repaid to it because Cascade had recovered more than an overpayment finally came to. One call issues one interest payment on its own remittance.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `provider_agreement_id` | Reference number of the network participation agreement the interest is paid under, as returned by the agreement lookup for the practice | Id |
| `interest_amount` | The interest paid | USD, non-negative, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent by the caller |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary confirming the payment:

- `status`: the text "paid" when the interest payment was issued;
- `entry_id`: reference number of the new payment entry;
- `provider_agreement_id`: echoed;
- `remittance_number`: the remittance advice number generated for this interest payment;
- `remittance_component`: the text "prompt_pay_interest";
- `amount`: USD with 2 decimal places;
- `event_date`: date YYYY-MM-DD of the payment.
